summary: Sanara MedTech Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 reporting the termination of a Transaction Advisory Services Agreement with The Catalyst Group. The agreement, effective March 1, 2023, covered advisory services for potential M&A and strategic transactions. Termination was mutual, effective June 2, 2026, with no fee or penalty paid. Indemnification and confidentiality covenants survive. The termination aligns with a strategic shift to focus on soft tissue repair and bone fusion products. This is a routine administrative update regarding a service contract, not a special situation deal event. No deal terms or transaction is involved.
